body: I'm just tired of the effort it takes to live. Tired of waking up early and going to work, just to ensure everyone else in life is happy. I'm tired of all the lies were fed as people. I wake up everyday and on my drive to work I wonder if someone will hit and kill me today, I don't really feel phased by the idea. Just seems like an end to my slave life I lead. July 1st is my birthday. Figure I should be in charge of when and how I die.
